605:t_008:4.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「You noticed, did you? Just what I'd expect from $$ニュータイプ$$s entrusted with humanity's future.」

605:t_008:6.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It's a $$コロニーレーザー$$.」

605:t_008:8.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「$$クロノ$$ intends to destroy that colony to erase $$ラプラスの箱$$ and $$サイアム・ビスト$$, the key to the truth beyond it.」

605:t_008:9.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「It seems their preparations are complete.」

605:t_008:10.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「So that's what you meant when you said there wasn't much time...!」

605:t_009:1.en:
$$オットー$$
「What are you planning to do, $$バナージ$$?!」

605:t_009:2.en:
$$バナージ$$
「I'll create a $$サイコ・フィールド$$ in front of $$メガラニカ$$!」

605:t_009:3.en:
$$レイアム$$
「You're going to block the $$コロニーレーザー$$?!」

605:t_009:4.en:
$$バナージ$$
「You can hear me too, right, $$オードリー$$? Evacuate with everyone there right now!」

605:t_009:7.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「My account is finished. But this marks a new beginning.」

605:t_009:8.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「I have a duty to find out what that beginning means.」

605:t_009:10.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「You are confident you can do it, aren't you?」

605:t_009:11.en:
$$ミネバ$$
「Then show me. ...And be sure to come back. I will not allow you to break your promise.」

605:t_009:12.en:
$$ジンネマン$$
「That's right! Make sure you come back!」

605:t_009:13.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Don't die, $$バナージ$$! I've had enough of people dying!」

605:t_009:14.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「Our battle isn't over yet! We still have to graduate from high school, you know!」

605:t_010:1.en:
$$リディ$$
「This $$バンシィ$$ is a psycho-machine too. It can help.」

605:t_010:2.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$... and what lies beneath it... aren't just your family's problem.」

605:t_010:3.en:
$$アムロ$$
「It's a problem for all of us... No, for everyone in the world.」

605:t_011:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「If the $$ユニコーン$$ can turn human will into power, use our feelings too.」

605:t_011:1.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm just an ordinary guy, so I might not be much help, but that's better than nothing!」

605:t_011:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「The $$ホワイトドール$$'s $$月光蝶$$ can help repel the beam too!」

605:t_011:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Machines with fields, move to the front! All other machines, move to the rear!」

605:t_011:5.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We all want to know what lies ahead.」

605:t_011:6.en:
$$シャア$$
「For that, we cannot allow $$メガラニカ$$ to be destroyed.」

605:t_011:7.en:
$$シン$$
「So let's do it. Let's bring all of $c's power together.」

605:t_011:8.en:
$$刹那$$
「I believe there is a future beyond this.」

605:t_011:9.en:
$$バナージ$$
「This is... what the $$ガンダム$$ has led us to... The strength to believe in hope and move into the future...」

605:t_011:10.en:
$$リディ$$
「My ancestor... $$リカルド・マーセナス$$ felt the same. He held a faint hope for the distant future and sent it forth with every prayer he could offer.」

605:t_011:11.en:
$$リディ$$
「Whether we turn it into a curse or a possibility, that's... It doesn't hurt to know. We were born into this world with a blessing.」

605:t_011:12.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you'd said that from the start... it would've been easier to understand...」

605:t_011:13.en:
$$リディ$$
「Fathers always leave something unsaid... Their children have to fill in the gaps themselves.」

605:t_012:0.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Are you so desperate you want to die with me, $n?」

605:t_012:3.en:
$n
「I absolutely refuse to believe that Miss $$スズネ$$ has disappeared from inside you!」

605:t_012:4.en:
$n
「So I won't let you do whatever you want with her body! Like hell I'll let you go and die!」

605:t_012:5.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「Are you all idiots...? You might survive if you run away.」

605:t_012:6.en:
$$ランド$$
「We can't move forward if we keep running away!」

605:t_012:7.en:
$$セツコ$$
「What's here is a legacy left by people who believed in the future and entrusted it to later generations!」

605:t_012:8.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Only by protecting that can we protect our own future.」

605:t_012:9.en:
$n
「You're joining us too, $$アムブリエル$$! To protect what we have to protect!」

605:t_012:10.en:
$$アムブリエル$$
「...Do whatever you want...」

605:t_012:11.en:
$$フェルト$$
「A high-energy mass is approaching!」

605:t_012:12.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「GN Field at full power! All units, bring your fields to maximum output!!」

605:t_012:13.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Bring our power together, $$ユニコーン$$!!」

605:t_013:1.en:
$$レイアム$$
「$$メガラニカ$$ and $c are both intact!」

605:t_013:5.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$ラプラスの箱$$ has been opened... Let's rest a little, $$バナージ$$.」

605:t_013:6.en:
$$リディ$$
「You've only just... been born, after all.」

605:t_013:10.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...Have you... become a vessel that receives human will...?」

605:t_013:11.en:
$$シャア$$
「One who connects people and turns that connection into power... Perhaps you are no longer... an individual being...」

605:t_013:12.en:
$$リディ$$
「Is this... a perfected $$ニュータイプ$$...?!」

605:t_013:14.en:
$$リディ$$
「You're too hasty...! Nobody asked for an outcome like this! Possibility is all we need!」

605:t_013:15.en:
$$リディ$$
「You and I both! We still have plenty to do in this world, don't we?! I swear I'll bring you back!」

605:t_013:18.en:
$$刹那$$
「Let's lend a little help, so $$バナージ$$ can wake up.」

605:t_014:0.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「GN particles... are filling this sector of space.」

605:t_014:1.en:
$$刹那$$
「Now our hearts will connect with $$バナージ$$.」
